title: Data Visualization Specialist
description: About the Product: For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections. Role Summary: We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio. Duties and Responsibilities: Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python) Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework. Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity. Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.G., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience. Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio. Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes. Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance. Data Querying and Performance Optimization Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions. Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load. Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.G., Python, SQL). User Experience (UX) and Data Design Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives. Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption. Knowledge/Skills/Abilities: Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio. Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git. Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer. Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery. Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly. Requirements: Advanced Proficiency in Shiny for Python: Deep expertise in developing, deploying, and managing production-grade Shiny applications, including a solid understanding of reactivity principles, modular design, and front-end styling. Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources. Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization. Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.G., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny. Experience with other BI platforms (e.G., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus. Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors. Credentials and Experience: College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field. 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment. We offer: We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health/Sport Budget. Fully remote.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description: We are looking for a full-time remote Senior Full Stack Web Application Developer with 7+ years of experience producing commercial grade software that is highly maintainable and supportable. The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent. Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The companys solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit through the automation of the most complex business processes to reduce operating costs, save time, and increase profitability via reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to the major integrated oil companies. Responsibilities: Maintain and enhance legacy application - JavaScript frontend and PHP backend running on linux, nginx (engine x), fpm and mostly mysql Modernize software solution using React.Js and/or Vue.Js design, architect, develop, deliver, and sustain Take technical ownership of features and their impact on the business - assist with refining functional and technical specifications Deliver product features and updates with minimal direction, yet know when to seek help to remain efficient Review and approve pull requests from less senior developers and assure alignment with established best practices Build and execute unit tests Interact with end-users/customers to ensure smooth deployments and to understand needs/issues Address defects identified during various testing cycles Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies Display comprehensive understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), as applied to projects of increasing size and complexity, with emphasis on: Problem solving Critical thinking Analysis and design Estimating Planning Required Experience: Excellent English communication skills 7+ years of full-stack software engineering experience 4+ years of experience using JavaScript, PHP, and linux Passion for whole product delivery and exceptional customer experiences must have experience considering architectural side-effects, edge-cases, backward compatibility, integrations, and internal/external team/customer enablement Experience building, delivering, and sustaining production, commercial-quality, n-tiered software architecture web-based applications Prior success as a senior developer coaching less skilled/experienced developers, establishing coding guidelines/best-practices, and reviewing pull requests Familiarity with varied data capture, normalization/transformation, and storage/management that enable high-performance data querying for reporting Experience working with Agile and other development methodologies Ability to work independently yet know when to seek assistance to be sure to achieve deadlines with high quality Team player with effective communication skills and collaborative approach Strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly Flexibility and openness to new ideas or change with the passion and drive to excel in their career Self-motivated, results-oriented, creative, and accountable Preferred experience: University degree or equivalent education (technical or engineering degree is optimal) Familiar with nginx web server (aka\ "Engine X\") Experience withReact.Js or Vue.Js Familiarity with upstream and midstream oil/gas industry Additional Information: Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big! You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions Work with smart and creative people Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent! We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays Start: ASAP About Velozient We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Data Visualization Specialist
description: About the Product: For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections. Role Summary: We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio. Duties and Responsibilities: Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python) Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework. Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity. Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.G., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience. Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio. Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes. Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance. Data Querying and Performance Optimization Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions. Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load. Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.G., Python, SQL). User Experience (UX) and Data Design Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives. Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption. Knowledge/Skills/Abilities: Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio. Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git. Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer. Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery. Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly. Requirements: Advanced Proficiency in Shiny for Python: Deep expertise in developing, deploying, and managing production-grade Shiny applications, including a solid understanding of reactivity principles, modular design, and front-end styling. Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources. Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization. Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.G., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny. Experience with other BI platforms (e.G., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus. Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors. Credentials and Experience: College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field. 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment. We offer: We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health/Sport Budget. Fully remote.

title: Software Engineer Full Stack Pleno
description:
Quem somos? Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Antifragilidade, pronto para desbravar entregas críticas para o sucesso do negócio;

criativa e sustentável.Sobre a Oportunidade:A Chavi é uma startup paranaense que desenvolve soluções de gerenciamento de acesso inteligente, substituindo chaves físicas por tecnologia: suas fechaduras engenheiros eletrônicos, mecânicos e de computação — o que garante controle completo sobre o produto e independência tecnológica.Projeto: Desenvolvimento de Fechadura InteligenteFormação comunicação (BLE, Wi-Fi, NB-IoT).- Desenvolver firmware para placa eletrônica.- Implementar sistema seguro de boot e atualizações OTA.- Apoiar no desenvolvimento da estrutura física do produto.- title: Data Visualization Specialist
description: About the Product: For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections. Role Summary: We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio. Duties and Responsibilities: Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python) Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework. Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity. Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.G., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience. Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio. Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes. Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance. Data Querying and Performance Optimization Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions. Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load. Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.G., Python, SQL). User Experience (UX) and Data Design Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives. Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption. Knowledge/Skills/Abilities: Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio. Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git. Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer. Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery. Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly. Requirements: Advanced Proficiency in Shiny for Python: Deep expertise in developing, deploying, and managing production-grade Shiny applications, including a solid understanding of reactivity principles, modular design, and front-end styling. Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources. Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization. Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.G., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny. Experience with other BI platforms (e.G., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus. Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors. Credentials and Experience: College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field. 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment. We offer: We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health/Sport Budget. Fully remote.

title: Data Visualization Specialist
description: About the Product: For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections. Role Summary: We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio. Duties and Responsibilities: Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python) Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework. Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity. Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.G., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience. Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio. Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes. Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance. Data Querying and Performance Optimization Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions. Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load. Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.G., Python, SQL). User Experience (UX) and Data Design Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives. Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption. Knowledge/Skills/Abilities: Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio. Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git. Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer. Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery. Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly. Requirements: Advanced Proficiency in Shiny for Python: Deep expertise in developing, deploying, and managing production-grade Shiny applications, including a solid understanding of reactivity principles, modular design, and front-end styling. Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources. Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization. Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.G., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny. Experience with other BI platforms (e.G., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus. Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors. Credentials and Experience: College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field. 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment. We offer: We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health/Sport Budget. Fully remote.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description: We are looking for a full-time remote Senior Full Stack Web Application Developer with 7+ years of experience producing commercial grade software that is highly maintainable and supportable. The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent. Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The companys solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit through the automation of the most complex business processes to reduce operating costs, save time, and increase profitability via reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to the major integrated oil companies. Responsibilities: Maintain and enhance legacy application - JavaScript frontend and PHP backend running on linux, nginx (engine x), fpm and mostly mysql Modernize software solution using React.Js and/or Vue.Js design, architect, develop, deliver, and sustain Take technical ownership of features and their impact on the business - assist with refining functional and technical specifications Deliver product features and updates with minimal direction, yet know when to seek help to remain efficient Review and approve pull requests from less senior developers and assure alignment with established best practices Build and execute unit tests Interact with end-users/customers to ensure smooth deployments and to understand needs/issues Address defects identified during various testing cycles Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies Display comprehensive understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), as applied to projects of increasing size and complexity, with emphasis on: Problem solving Critical thinking Analysis and design Estimating Planning Required Experience: Excellent English communication skills 7+ years of full-stack software engineering experience 4+ years of experience using JavaScript, PHP, and linux Passion for whole product delivery and exceptional customer experiences must have experience considering architectural side-effects, edge-cases, backward compatibility, integrations, and internal/external team/customer enablement Experience building, delivering, and sustaining production, commercial-quality, n-tiered software architecture web-based applications Prior success as a senior developer coaching less skilled/experienced developers, establishing coding guidelines/best-practices, and reviewing pull requests Familiarity with varied data capture, normalization/transformation, and storage/management that enable high-performance data querying for reporting Experience working with Agile and other development methodologies Ability to work independently yet know when to seek assistance to be sure to achieve deadlines with high quality Team player with effective communication skills and collaborative approach Strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly Flexibility and openness to new ideas or change with the passion and drive to excel in their career Self-motivated, results-oriented, creative, and accountable Preferred experience: University degree or equivalent education (technical or engineering degree is optimal) Familiar with nginx web server (aka\ "Engine X\") Experience withReact.Js or Vue.Js Familiarity with upstream and midstream oil/gas industry Additional Information: Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big! You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions Work with smart and creative people Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent! We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays Start: ASAP About Velozient We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Devops Engineer
description: About the Opportunity We are looking for an experienced a DevOps Engineer to support the transition of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) backend system from a Proof of Concept (PoC) to a scalable, production-ready platform. This role will focus on building, configuring, and deploying a serverless architecture leveraging AWS Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS PostgreSQL, and other managed services. You will collaborate closely with RedTeam’s existing .NET backend team to integrate a new Backend RAG API Service, enabling semantic search on construction specification documents through existing frontend applications. Responsibilities Infrastructure Provisioning Execute curated deployment scripts using the AWS SDK. Provision the full serverless architecture: API Gateway, Lambda, RDS (PostgreSQL), VPC components, and Bedrock Knowledge Base. API Gateway Configuration Deploy and configure RESTful API endpoints for chat query orchestration. Ensure correct integration with the customer’s .NET API, where authentication/authorization is handled (no native AWS auth). AWS Lambda Deployment Deploy the API Orchestrator Lambda and the Ingestion & KB Sync Lambda functions. Ensure Lambdas run inside the VPC and can be invoked by the customer’s .NET backend. Networking & Security Configure VPC networking, subnets, and access control for RDS connections. Implement pragmatic least-privilege IAM policies for all components. S3 Integration Setup Configure Amazon S3 as the corpus data source for the AWS Bedrock Knowledge Base. Enable automatic synchronization between the S3 bucket and the Knowledge Base. Database Deployment Deploy and configure the Amazon RDS PostgreSQL instance for chat history and conversation memory. Execute necessary DDL changes and schema configuration. Observability Setup Configure CloudWatch logs and alarms for monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational health. Required Qualifications Strong hands-on experience with AWS Serverless Architecture (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB or RDS). Experience provisioning AWS environments using AWS SDK, IaC scripts, or automated deployment pipelines. Proficiency with VPC networking, IAM security policies, and integrating private Lambdas with RDS. Knowledge of RDS (PostgreSQL) administration and schema deployment. Experience with CloudWatch for logging, metrics, and alarm configuration. Ability to integrate backend services with external APIs, especially .NET-based systems. Nice to Have Skills Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures. Familiarity with AWS Bedrock, Bedrock Knowledge Base, and generative AI workloads. Working knowledge of semantic search, embeddings, or vector-based search systems. Experience with .NET backend integration or hybrid cloud/backend environments. Exposure to infra-as-code tools (CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform). Background in serverless best practices, scalability, and production hardening. Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

Quem somos nós? Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos. Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios, exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor. Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar! Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que: Contratação: CLT Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas. Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra. Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação. O que buscamos? Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis. Como será seu dia-a-dia? Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (GCP), garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência. Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform. Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab, automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega. Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD, assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações. Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes, monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters. Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos. Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes. Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade. Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura. Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar: Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes, com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção. Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD, incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado. Experiência com GitLab, aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud. Conhecimento aprofundado em GCP, com vivência prática em serviços como Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos. Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform, incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura. Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing. Experiência com scripting e automação, utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações. Vivência prática com CI/CD, desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green). Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers, incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade. Será um diferencial se você tiver: Experiência com Oracle Cloud (OCI). O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders? Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
Auxílio Home-Office nocartão Caju;
Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;

Auxílio à Saúde Física- acesso ao aplicativo Gympass ;
Seguro de vida. Todasas nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. title: Data Visualization Specialist
description: About the Product: For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections. Role Summary: We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio. Duties and Responsibilities: Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python) Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework. Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity. Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.G., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience. Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio. Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes. Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance. Data Querying and Performance Optimization Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions. Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load. Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.G., Python, SQL). User Experience (UX) and Data Design Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives. Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption. Knowledge/Skills/Abilities: Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio. Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git. Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer. Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery. Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly. Requirements: Advanced Proficiency in Shiny for Python: Deep expertise in developing, deploying, and managing production-grade Shiny applications, including a solid understanding of reactivity principles, modular design, and front-end styling. Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources. Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization. Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.G., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny. Experience with other BI platforms (e.G., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus. Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors. Credentials and Experience: College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field. 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment. We offer: We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health/Sport Budget. Fully remote.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description: We are looking for a full-time remote Senior Full Stack Web Application Developer with 7+ years of experience producing commercial grade software that is highly maintainable and supportable. The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent. Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. title: Software Engineer Full Stack Pleno
description:
Quem somos? Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões de rodada em investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil. A TM Digital é a divisão tecnológica da TerraMagna responsável por levar todas as nossas inovações para o mercado. Nossa jornada começou com a tecnologia, identificamos os desafios comuns do agronegócio e expandimos para o financiamento graças à nossa expertise em gestão de riscos em tempo real, um reflexo da nossa solidez tecnológica. Nosso propósito é fortalecer a cadeia de distribuição de insumos e transformar a maneira como o crédito é concedido e recebido no agronegócio brasileiro. Por isso, dividimos a credibilidade tecnológica que permitiu a TerraMagna se tornar o que é para o mercado agro. A tecnologia está no centro do que fazemos. Nossas equipes de desenvolvimento, arquitetura de sistemas, banco de dados, experiência do usuário, cibersegurança e data & analytics atuam em conjunto para construir o sistema operacional do agronegócio. Em um setor que se transforma todos os dias, somos reconhecidos por liderar essa mudança com visão estratégica. Responsabilidades e atribuições: Desenvolver interfaces de usuário modernas e responsivas e participar ativamente da implementação de soluções escaláveis e resilientes;
Trabalhar transversalmente com squads, garantindo boas práticas de engenharia e decisões consistentes com a visão de longo prazo da plataforma;
Contribuir comrevisõesde código, design de sistemas, arquitetura e iniciativas de refatoração estratégica;
Colaborar com áreas deproduto e negócios para traduzir necessidades em soluções técnicas viáveis;
Garantir excelência naexperiência do usuário e performance front-end;
Conduzir iniciativas de inovação tecnológica, incluindo POCs e adoção de novas ferramentas ou paradigmas. Competências: Experiência com stacks como: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, Node.Js (NestJS), PostgreSQL.. Experiência anterior em ambientes altamente regulados ou em fintechs / agtechs / software as a service (saas);
Participação ativa em comunidades técnicas ou iniciativas open source;
Antifragilidade, pronto para desbravar entregas críticas para o sucesso do negócio;
Experiência com desenvolvimento de software e design de arquitetura de serviços e dados;
Excelentes habilidadesde comunicação e colaboração. Requisitos: Graduação em Engenharia;
Sólida experiência em engenharia de software (4+ anos), com histórico de impacto técnico significativo;
Experiência com Angular e desenvolvimento de SPAs (Single Page Applications);
Experiência com APIs REST;
Vivência com infraestrutura em nuvem (preferencialmente GCP), automação de infraestrutura (IaC), CI/CD e observabilidade;
Experiência com bancosde dados relacionais (preferencialmente PostgreSQL) e não relacionais em alta escala;
Habilidade de comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e não técnicas. Diferenciais: Conhecimento ou experiência com Rust;
Experiência com processamento de dados geoespaciais no front-end (mapas, geolocalização);
Conhecimento sobre os conceitos base da Cloud – containers, VMs e GCP (organização, projetos, regiões, zonas, IAM);
Conhecimento dos principais conceitos e funcionalidades como Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, etc;
Conhecimento em Terraform. O que temos por aqui: Remuneração compatível com o mercado (PJ);
Benefício flexível pormeio do cartão Swile;
Gympass;
Convêniomédico Porto Saúde;
Convênio odontológico Uniodonto;
Modelo de trabalho remoto.

title: Data Visualization Specialist
description: About the Product: For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections. Role Summary: We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio. Duties and Responsibilities: Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python) Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework. Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity. Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.G., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience. Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio. Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes. Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance. Data Querying and Performance Optimization Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions. Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load. Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.G., Python, SQL). User Experience (UX) and Data Design Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives. Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption. Knowledge/Skills/Abilities: Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio. Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git. Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer. description: About the Product: For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio. Duties and Responsibilities: Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python) Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework. Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity. Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.G., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience. Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio. Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes. Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance. Data Querying and Performance Optimization Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions. Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load. Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.G., Python, SQL). User Experience (UX) and Data Design Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives. Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption. Knowledge/Skills/Abilities: Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio. Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git. Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer. Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery. Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly. Requirements: Advanced Proficiency in Shiny for Python: Deep expertise in developing, deploying, and managing production-grade Shiny applications, including a solid understanding of reactivity principles, modular design, and front-end styling. Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources. Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization. Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.G., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny. Experience with other BI platforms (e.G., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus. Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors. Credentials and Experience: College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field. 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment. We offer: We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health/Sport Budget. Fully remote.

title: Network Implementation Engineer
description:
Job Title: L3 Network Operations and Implementation Engineer – LAN/WLAN Job Summary: We are seeking a skilled and motivated L3 Network Engineer provide Level 3 network support and to implement LAN and WLAN infrastructure at sites across the North and South America. The ideal candidate will hold at least a CCNA certification, possess strong experience in configuring Cisco network switches and wireless access points, and can manage third-party wiring vendors effectively. This role requires a commitment to extensive travel, flexibility to work off-hours and weekends, and a focus on delivering high-quality network solutions in a dynamic environment. Trilingual in Portuguese, English and Spanish. Key Responsibilities: - Configure switches and wireless access points.
- Perform site assessments to evaluate current network infrastructure and develop action plans for equipment refresh.
- Work collaboratively with wiring vendors to oversee and ensure proper cabling and device installations and terminations meet project standards.
- Manage and troubleshoot network issues during the deployment and provide Level 3 hyper care support as needed.
- Document network configurations, topologies, and changes to maintain accurate records.
- Adhere to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining high standards of quality and performance.
- Travel extensively (up to 25%) to various sites across South America, Mexico, the United States and Canada, including weekends and off-hours work as necessary. Qualifications: - Minimum Certification: CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate), CCNP (Cisco Certified Network Professional) preferred.
- Proven experience in deploying and managing network devices, including Cisco and Juniper switches and wireless access points.
- Strong knowledge of LAN/WLAN networking protocols.
- Familiarity with cabling standards and experience managing wiring vendors.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in fast-paced environments.
- Strong communication skills to interact effectively with team members, vendors, and stakeholders.
- Availability to travel internationally, extensively (up to 25%) and work weekends or during off-hours as required. title: Business Developer For Social Media
description: Job Description   At Pluria Global, we continue to grow at an extraordinary pace. That’s why we’re looking for a true rockstar to join our mission of redefining how people and companies work together. We provide companies and employees with a disruptive solution that enables them to work from any workspace affiliated with our network (coworking spaces, business centers, private and flexible offices, hotels, libraries, cafés), where users can find and book their workspace in just one click. Unlock potential through real connections.   Pluria is a multinational startup founded in Romania, with presence in Spain, Argentina, Peru, Mexico, Chile, Brazil, Portugal, and Colombia. Our goal is to become the global solution that supports companies on their journey to becoming flexible organizations. We operate in a market growing 215% in LatAm and 55% in Colombia.   At Pluria, we believe the true engine of progress lies in real connections : when teams feel connected, both people and companies thrive. That’s why our purpose is to create connected teams that boost engagement, innovation, and results—because better companies lead to better economies and, ultimately, a better quality of life.    We achieve this by bringing together three forces: A network of locations that brings offices, hubs, and flexible spaces into one accessible network. Bottom-up coordination, enabling intentional encounters through bookings, invitations, and approvals. Top-down intelligence, delivering actionable data so leaders can make better decisions. This is how we unlock true performance by transforming work into a space for connection, collaboration, and shared growth.   Some numbers that back us up: Global presence in over 10 countries More than 1,000 workspaces worldwide 20% month-over-month growth A global team of 30+ people 100% remote and multicultural team

description: We are looking for a full-time remote Senior Full Stack Web Application Developer with 7+ years of experience producing commercial grade software that is highly maintainable and supportable. title: Data Visualization Specialist
description: About the Product: For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections. Role Summary: We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio. Duties and Responsibilities: Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python) Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework. Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity. Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.G., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience. Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio. Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes. Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance. Data Querying and Performance Optimization Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions. Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load. Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.G., Python, SQL). User Experience (UX) and Data Design Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives. Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption. Knowledge/Skills/Abilities: Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio. Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git. Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer. Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery. Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly. Requirements: Advanced Proficiency in Shiny for Python: Deep expertise in developing, deploying, and managing production-grade Shiny applications, including a solid understanding of reactivity principles, modular design, and front-end styling. Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources. Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization. Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.G., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny. Experience with other BI platforms (e.G., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus. Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors. Credentials and Experience: College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field. 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment. We offer: We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health/Sport Budget. Fully remote.

title: Analista De Suporte De Ti
description: Job Description   At Pluria Global, we continue to grow at an extraordinary pace. That’s why we’re looking for a true rockstar to join our mission of redefining how people and companies work together. We provide companies and employees with a disruptive solution that enables them to work from any workspace affiliated with our network (coworking spaces, business centers, private and flexible offices, hotels, libraries, cafés), where users can find and book their workspace in just one click. Unlock potential through real connections.   Pluria is a multinational startup founded in Romania, with presence in Spain, Argentina, Peru, Mexico, Chile, Brazil, Portugal, and Colombia. Our goal is to become the global solution that supports companies on their journey to becoming flexible organizations. We operate in a market growing 215% in LatAm and 55% in Colombia.   At Pluria, we believe the true engine of progress lies in real connections : when teams feel connected, both people and companies thrive. That’s why our purpose is to create connected teams that boost engagement, innovation, and results—because better companies lead to better economies and, ultimately, a better quality of life.    We achieve this by bringing together three forces: A network of locations that brings offices, hubs, and flexible spaces into one accessible network. Bottom-up coordination, enabling intentional encounters through bookings, invitations, and approvals. Top-down intelligence, delivering actionable data so leaders can make better decisions. This is how we unlock true performance by transforming work into a space for connection, collaboration, and shared growth.   Some numbers that back us up: Global presence in over 10 countries More than 1,000 workspaces worldwide 20% month-over-month growth A global team of 30+ people 100% remote and multicultural team

title: Business Developer For Social Media
description: Job Description   At Pluria Global, we continue to grow at an extraordinary pace. That’s why we’re looking for a true rockstar to join our mission of redefining how people and companies work together. We provide companies and employees with a disruptive solution that enables them to work from any workspace affiliated with our network (coworking spaces, business centers, private and flexible offices, hotels, libraries, cafés), where users can find and book their workspace in just one click. Unlock potential through real connections.   Pluria is a multinational startup founded in Romania, with presence in Spain, Argentina, Peru, Mexico, Chile, Brazil, Portugal, and Colombia. Our goal is to become the global solution that supports companies on their journey to becoming flexible organizations. We operate in a market growing 215% in LatAm and 55% in Colombia.   At Pluria, we believe the true engine of progress lies in real connections : when teams feel connected, both people and companies thrive. That’s why our purpose is to create connected teams that boost engagement, innovation, and results—because better companies lead to better economies and, ultimately, a better quality of life.    We achieve this by bringing together three forces: A network of locations that brings offices, hubs, and flexible spaces into one accessible network. Bottom-up coordination, enabling intentional encounters through bookings, invitations, and approvals. Top-down intelligence, delivering actionable data so leaders can make better decisions. This is how we unlock true performance by transforming work into a space for connection, collaboration, and shared growth.   Some numbers that back us up: Global presence in over 10 countries More than 1,000 workspaces worldwide 20% month-over-month growth A global team of 30+ people 100% remote and multicultural team

title: Data Visualization Specialist
description: About the Product: For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections. Role Summary: We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio. Duties and Responsibilities: Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python) Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework. Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity. Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.G., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience. Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio. Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes. Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance. Data Querying and Performance Optimization Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions. Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load. Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.G., Python, SQL). User Experience (UX) and Data Design Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives. Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption. Knowledge/Skills/Abilities: Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio. Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git. Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer. Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery. Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly. Requirements: Advanced Proficiency in Shiny for Python: Deep expertise in developing, deploying, and managing production-grade Shiny applications, including a solid understanding of reactivity principles, modular design, and front-end styling. Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources. Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization. Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.G., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny. Experience with other BI platforms (e.G., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus. Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors. Antifragilidade, pronto para desbravar entregas críticas para o sucesso do negócio;
Experiência com desenvolvimento de software e design de arquitetura de serviços e dados;
Excelentes habilidadesde comunicação e colaboração. Requisitos: Graduação em Engenharia;

title: Especialista Em Kafka & Cdc (Debezium)
description: Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional especialista em Apache Kafka e Change Data Capture (CDC) com Debezium, para atuar na administração, operação e evolução de ambientes críticos de streaming de dados em produção. O(a) profissional será responsável por garantir alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade, observabilidade e confiabilidade das plataformas de mensageria e CDC. Conhecimento de ferramentas de observabilidade e operação : Prometheus Grafana Confluent Control Center Kafka UI ou similares Requisitos Técnicos – Debezium e CDC Experiência prática em Debezium como solução de CDC. Conhecimento em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos. Vivência com ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP). Conhecimento em segurança aplicada a Kafka e Kafka Connect. O que oferecemos Atuação em projetos estratégicos e de alta complexidade técnica. Ambiente colaborativo e focado em excelência técnica. Oportunidade de crescimento e especialização em streaming e dados em tempo real.

Com mais de 94.000 funcionários dedicados, não geramos apenas eletricidade para mais de 16% da comunidade global, mas também usamos nossa tecnologia para ajudar a proteger as pessoas e o meio ambiente. Mantemos um legado de 150 anos de inovação que incentiva nossa busca por pessoas que apoiarão nosso foco em descarbonização, novas tecnologias e transformação de energia. Nosso compromisso com a diversidade Para nossa sorte, não somos todos iguais. Através da diversidade geramos energia. Trabalhamos com inclusão e nossa energia criativa combinada é alimentada por mais de 130 nacionalidades. A Siemens Energy celebra o caráter, independentemente de origem étnica, sexo, idade, religião, identidade ou deficiência.
