title: Analista De Departamento Pessoal
description:
Se você acredita que pessoas são o maior diferencial de uma empresa e gosta de criar experiências que inspiram, engajam e desenvolvem talentos, essa vaga é para você! Aqui cada ação, desde a integração de novos colaboradores até a construção de trilhas de aprendizagem, programa de liderança e acompanhamento de avaliação de desempenho faz diferença na jornada de crescimento e você pode ser parte disso! No dia a dia, você vai: - Planejar, executar e acompanhar o Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) dos colaboradores, apoiando líderes na condução e acompanhamento.
- Estruturar e aplicar Pesquisas de Clima Organizacional - Organizar e conduzir treinamentos, workshops e programas de capacitação, incluindo a logística de hospedagem, transporte e alimentação, quando necessário.
- Elaborar trilha e workshops de treinamento de liderança e públicos administrativos/corporativos - Atualizar e manter bases de dados em sistemas de gestão de RH/DHO, assegurando informações corretas e atualizadas.
- Apoiar programas de Gestão de Desempenho, desde a comunicação até a coleta e consolidação dos resultados.
- Conduzir e aprimorar o processo de onboarding/boas-vindas de novos colaboradores, garantindo uma integração acolhedora, eficiente e alinhada à cultura da empresa.
- Atuar de forma proativa na resolução de problemas e conflitos, garantindo agilidade e qualidade nas entregas.
- Apoiar projetos em geral da área de DHO - Pesquisar e propor tendências de mercado em DHO, inovação em metodologias de aprendizagem e ferramentas digitais. Manter a confidencialidade das informações organizacionais e de colaboradores, assegurando sigilo e ética em todos os processos. E quais os requisitos para trabalhar conosco?- Nível Superior Completo (preferencialmente em Psicologia, Gestão de RH, Pedagogia, Administração ou similares)- Atuação com Desenvolvimento Humano Organizacional (treinamento, desenvolvimento, criação de trilhas para líderes e equipes administrativas, avaliação de desempenho, pesquisa de clima, integração de novos colaboradores, PDI, dentre outros temas de DHO)- Atuação com ferramentas de DHO - Experiência com estrutura/área administrativa - Experiência no ramo alimentício, varejo e/ou farmácias.
- Familiaridade com ferramentas do Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Slides, Drive, Meet, Forms) para suporte a processos de DHO. Diferencial: - Vivência com a plataforma Qulture Rocks, especialmente em gestão de performance, avaliação de desempenho, metas e sucessão.
- Conhecimento em ferramentas de design como Canva e outros, para criação de materiais visuais de comunicação e apoio a treinamentos. E sabe quais benefícios você terá conosco? - Seu bônus/PLR será baseado no seu atingimento de metas e poderá chegar em até 3 salários a partir do mês seguinte a sua admissão;
- Para seu deslocamento, terá vale-transporte;
- Garantindo suaalimentação diária, fornecemos vale-refeição/alimentação (R$42,00/dia)- Sua saúde vem em primeiro lugar, por isso oferecemos Assistência Médica (20% de coparticipação), Assistência Odontológica (100% da mensalidade pago pela empresa), Programa de Apoio ao Colaborador (extensivo à dependentes) e Seguro de Vida;
- Além disso, você aqui você também tem Wellhub/Gympass (extensivo à dependentes);
- Parceria? Temos! Contamos com parceria com o SESC e instituições de ensino;
- 50% de desconto em produtos Bacio di Latte. Delícia né? Localização: Itaim Bibi/SP Formato de trabalho: Presencial

title: Desenvolvedor
description: Desenvolvedor(a) Go Sênior — Cloud Modernization (AWS) Estamos liderando um projeto estratégico de transformação tecnológica, modernizando todo um ecossistema on-premise para a AWS, adotando arquiteturas modernas, alta performance, resiliência e segurança como pilares fundamentais. Você terá a oportunidade de atuar com protagonismo técnico em um ambiente complexo, de grande impacto para o negócio e com foco na evolução contínua da plataforma. A atuação será remota, com preferência por profissionais sediados no estado de São Paulo, devido a possíveis encontros presenciais em momentos estratégicos. O projeto é de longa duração e alto grau de inovação. Responsabilidades Projetar, desenvolver e evoluir aplicações de software alinhadas às iniciativas de negócio. Colaborar com times multifuncionais para levantamento de requisitos e definição de soluções. Mapear aplicações, dependências e integrações para suportar arquiteturas de migração: lift-and-shift, replatform e refactor. Construir serviços de alta performance e baixa latência, com foco em escalabilidade, observabilidade e segurança. Requisitos Obrigatórios Experiência Mais de 8 anos em desenvolvimento de software. Mais de 4 anos com Go. Mais de 3 anos com AWS ou plataformas similares. Mais de 3 anos com CI/CD e práticas DevOps. Conhecimentos avançados em Go Generics, contexts, tratamento de erros. Concorrência (goroutines, channels avançados e pacote sync). Otimização de performance pprof, benchmarks. Escape analysis. Otimização de alocação de memória. Arquitetura e Design Microservices, arquitetura hexagonal, arquitetura reativa. Clean Architecture / Vertical Slice. Design Patterns: Strategy, Abstract Factory, Chain of Responsibility. Cloud Native Patterns: CQRS, Retry Pattern, Circuit Breaker. Integrações e Observabilidade Mensageria via TCP Sockets e brokers (Kafka ou RabbitMQ). Testes: unitários, de contrato, de carga. Ferramentas de rastreabilidade: Splunk, AWS CloudWatch. Ferramentas de observabilidade: Dynatrace, Distributed Tracing (Jaeger / Zipkin), Grafana. Infraestrutura e Plataforma Kubernetes (deploys, HPA/VPA). Containerização com Docker. Diferenciais Experiência com protocolos de redes de pagamento – ISO 8583. Conhecimentos em padrões de segurança: PCI DSS HSM Tokenização

title: Pmo Sap
description:

title: Software Engineer Full Stack Pleno
description:
Quem somos? Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões de rodada em investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil. A TM Digital é a divisão tecnológica da TerraMagna responsável por levar todas as nossas inovações para o mercado. Nossa jornada começou com a tecnologia, identificamos os desafios comuns do agronegócio e expandimos para o financiamento graças à nossa expertise em gestão de riscos em tempo real, um reflexo da nossa solidez tecnológica. Nosso propósito é fortalecer a cadeia de distribuição de insumos e transformar a maneira como o crédito é concedido e recebido no agronegócio brasileiro. Por isso, dividimos a credibilidade tecnológica que permitiu a TerraMagna se tornar o que é para o mercado agro. A tecnologia está no centro do que fazemos. Nossas equipes de desenvolvimento, arquitetura de sistemas, banco de dados, experiência do usuário, cibersegurança e data & analytics atuam em conjunto para construir o sistema operacional do agronegócio. Em um setor que se transforma todos os dias, somos reconhecidos por liderar essa mudança com visão estratégica. Responsabilidades e atribuições: Desenvolver interfaces de usuário modernas e responsivas e participar ativamente da implementação de soluções escaláveis e resilientes;
Trabalhar transversalmente com squads, garantindo boas práticas de engenharia e decisões consistentes com a visão de longo prazo da plataforma;
Contribuir comrevisõesde código, design de sistemas, arquitetura e iniciativas de refatoração estratégica;
Colaborar com áreas deproduto e negócios para traduzir necessidades em soluções técnicas viáveis;
Garantir excelência naexperiência do usuário e performance front-end;
Conduzir iniciativas de inovação tecnológica, incluindo POCs e adoção de novas ferramentas ou paradigmas. Competências: Experiência com stacks como: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, Node.Js (NestJS), PostgreSQL.. Experiência anterior em ambientes altamente regulados ou em fintechs / agtechs / software as a service (saas);
Participação ativa em comunidades técnicas ou iniciativas open source;
Antifragilidade, pronto para desbravar entregas críticas para o sucesso do negócio;
Experiência com desenvolvimento de software e design de arquitetura de serviços e dados;
Excelentes habilidadesde comunicação e colaboração. Requisitos: Graduação em Engenharia;
Sólida experiência em engenharia de software (4+ anos), com histórico de impacto técnico significativo;
Experiência com Angular e desenvolvimento de SPAs (Single Page Applications);
Experiência com APIs REST;
Vivência com infraestrutura em nuvem (preferencialmente GCP), automação de infraestrutura (IaC), CI/CD e observabilidade;
Experiência com bancosde dados relacionais (preferencialmente PostgreSQL) e não relacionais em alta escala;
Habilidade de comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e não técnicas. Diferenciais: Conhecimento ou experiência com Rust;
Experiência com processamento de dados geoespaciais no front-end (mapas, geolocalização);
Conhecimento sobre os conceitos base da Cloud – containers, VMs e GCP (organização, projetos, regiões, zonas, IAM);
Conhecimento dos principais conceitos e funcionalidades como Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, etc;
Conhecimento em Terraform. O que temos por aqui: Remuneração compatível com o mercado (PJ);
Benefício flexível pormeio do cartão Swile;
Gympass;
Convêniomédico Porto Saúde;
Convênio odontológico Uniodonto;
Modelo de trabalho remoto.

title: Data Visualization Specialist
description: About the Product: For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections. Role Summary: We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio. Duties and Responsibilities: Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python) Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework. Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity. Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.G., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience. Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio. Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes. Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance. Data Querying and Performance Optimization Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions. Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load. Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.G., Python, SQL). User Experience (UX) and Data Design Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives. Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption. Knowledge/Skills/Abilities: Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio. Se você é um profissional com deficiência ou reabilitado e deseja fazer parte de uma empresa que cresce a cada dia, cadastre seu currículo no nosso banco de talentos e venha trabalhar com a gente! Confira abaixo as regiões que temos vagas para diversos setores: São Paulo Rio de Janeiro Pernambuco Distrito Federal Rio Grande do Sul Minas Gerais Para saber mais sobre nossa história acesse nosso site: Aqui prezamos pela igualdade de oportunidade e inclusão da diversidade. Para nós, isso se iguala em gênero e identidade de gênero, religião, PCD's, LGBTQIA+, raça/etnia, idade e o fortalecimento do papel da Mulher. Acreditamos que é muito valioso para nossa Cultura compartilhar ideias e pontos de vista diferentes. Venha fazer parte para continuarmos transformando e alimentando um mundo melhor! #ElasSabem #SejaVocê #DeMachosaHomens #EntreRaças #Além #GerAções

title: Data Visualization Specialist
description: About the Product: For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections. Role Summary: We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio. Duties and Responsibilities: Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python) Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework. Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity. Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.G., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience. Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio. Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes. Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance. Data Querying and Performance Optimization Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions. Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load. Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.G., Python, SQL). User Experience (UX) and Data Design Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives. Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption. Knowledge/Skills/Abilities: Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio. Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git. Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer. Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery. Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly. Requirements: Advanced Proficiency in Shiny for Python: Deep expertise in developing, deploying, and managing production-grade Shiny applications, including a solid understanding of reactivity principles, modular design, and front-end styling. Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources. Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization. Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.G., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny. Experience with other BI platforms (e.G., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus. Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors. Credentials and Experience: College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field. 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment. We offer: We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health/Sport Budget. Fully remote.

Analisar tendências do mercado e fazer recomendações sobre ajustes na estrutura de remuneração. Manutenção de Dados e Documentação: Garantir a precisão e a integridade dos dados relacionados à remuneração, orçamento e mobilidade global, mantendo registros atualizados e precisos. Isso inclui a criação e manutenção de documentação relevante, como políticas de remuneração, procedimentos de orçamento e diretrizes de mobilidade. title: Sr. Technical Customer Success Analyst
description: Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst Business Unit: Graphic Communications Location: Brazil, Remote Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst, you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success, you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success. In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues. Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability. Key Responsibilities Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy. Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence. Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact. Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions. Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment. Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance. Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution. Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions. Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details. Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation. Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues. Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases. Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics. Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers. Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity. Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates. Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements. Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required. Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures. Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL. Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers. Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools. Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries. Utilize network tracing tools (e.G., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues. Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues. Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components. Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments. Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators. Experience Requirements Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience. ERP/MIS background preferred. Print industry knowledge is mandatory. Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred. Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies. Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment. Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance. Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance. Willing to work in shifts as required. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Strong documentation and organizational abilities. Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics). Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication. Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL. Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting. Education Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems. Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

title: Angular Developer
description: Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Angular Sênior para atuar em projetos de alta complexidade, construindo aplicações modernas, escaláveis e com foco em performance e experiência do usuário. Você fará parte de um time técnico e colaborativo, contribuindo com decisões arquiteturais e boas práticas na evolução de produtos estratégicos. Responsabilidades Desenvolver, evoluir e manter aplicações front-end usando Angular 16+. Participar da definição de arquitetura, padrões e melhores práticas. Implementar interfaces responsivas, acessíveis e de alta performance. Realizar code reviews e apoiar o time no aprimoramento da qualidade técnica. Integrar o front-end com APIs e microsserviços. Contribuir com documentação, testes e melhoria contínua dos processos. Trabalhar em parceria com UX/UI, backend e demais times técnicos. Requisitos obrigatórios Experiência avançada em Angular 16+. Domínio de TypeScript, HTML5 e CSS3 (incluindo pré-processadores). Conhecimento sólido em RxJS, State Management (NgRx, Akita, Signals etc.). Experiência com componentização, roteamento e arquitetura modular. Boa compreensão de integração com APIs REST. Familiaridade com testes unitários (Jest, Jasmine, Karma). Experiência com ferramentas de build (Angular CLI, Webpack, Vite). Vivência com versionamento Git. Diferenciais Conhecimento em CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps…). Experiência com micro frontends. Noções de UX e acessibilidade (WCAG). Experiência em projetos de larga escala e alto volume de usuários. Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban). Na CWI Software, acreditamos que o sucesso de nossos projetos está diretamente ligado ao bem-estar e desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores. Por isso, oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, com oportunidades de crescimento profissional e valorização da cultura da empresa. Vem construir soluções incríveis com a gente!

title: Network Implementation Engineer
description:
Job Title: L3 Network Operations and Implementation Engineer – LAN/WLAN Job Summary: We are seeking a skilled and motivated L3 Network Engineer provide Level 3 network support and to implement LAN and WLAN infrastructure at sites across the North and South America. The ideal candidate will hold at least a CCNA certification, possess strong experience in configuring Cisco network switches and wireless access points, and can manage third-party wiring vendors effectively. This role requires a commitment to extensive travel, flexibility to work off-hours and weekends, and a focus on delivering high-quality network solutions in a dynamic environment. Trilingual in Portuguese, English and Spanish. Key Responsibilities: - Configure switches and wireless access points.
- Perform site assessments to evaluate current network infrastructure and develop action plans for equipment refresh.
- Work collaboratively with wiring vendors to oversee and ensure proper cabling and device installations and terminations meet project standards.
- Manage and troubleshoot network issues during the deployment and provide Level 3 hyper care support as needed.
- Document network configurations, topologies, and changes to maintain accurate records.
- Adhere to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining high standards of quality and performance.
- Travel extensively (up to 25%) to various sites across South America, Mexico, the United States and Canada, including weekends and off-hours work as necessary. Qualifications: - Minimum Certification: CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate), CCNP (Cisco Certified Network Professional) preferred.
- Proven experience in deploying and managing network devices, including Cisco and Juniper switches and wireless access points.
- Strong knowledge of LAN/WLAN networking protocols.
- Familiarity with cabling standards and experience managing wiring vendors.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in fast-paced environments.
- Strong communication skills to interact effectively with team members, vendors, and stakeholders.
- Availability to travel internationally, extensively (up to 25%) and work weekends or during off-hours as required. Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Agencies Bd For Social App
description: Apesar de ter muitas aplicações não deixe de se aplicar, focamos em talentos específicos e não iremos entrevistar qualquer pessoa para a equipe. Se acredita que tenha 100% de fit conosco, se candidate. Regime: PJ | Full Remote | Tempo integral Sobre a ReviewAll Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A/B/C/D até grandes multinacionais. O ano de 2025 foi ótimo para nós, crescemos 155% e mais que dobramos nosso time de operações! Buscamos novas pessoas para nosso time de recrutamento que queiram fazer parte desse crescimento acelerado: Principais responsabilidades Gerenciar de 8 a 12 processos seletivos simultâneos nas áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócios. Grande parte das vagas em nível executivo. Conduzir o recrutamento end-to-end. Alinhamento de perfil diretamente com o cliente final e área de pessoas de nossos clientes. Sourcing ativo (LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking) Triagem de currículos e entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais Apresentação de shortlist e negociação de oferta Acompanhamento de onboarding Ser ponto único de contato para stakeholders (tech leads, PMs, diretores e founders), garantindo clareza de expectativas Requisitos Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior. Experiência: Sólida em executive/tech search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida/efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados. Perfil Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados Excelente comunicação interpessoal Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada. Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo. Infraestrutura Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui. Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados. Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade. Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda. Pacote de remuneração Salário Fixo PJ Variável mensal: potencial médio de R$ 4.500 – 12.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$6.500 - 9.000), sem teto.

title: Network Implementation Engineer
description:
Job Title: L3 Network Operations and Implementation Engineer – LAN/WLAN Job Summary: We are seeking a skilled and motivated L3 Network Engineer provide Level 3 network support and to implement LAN and WLAN infrastructure at sites across the North and South America. The ideal candidate will hold at least a CCNA certification, possess strong experience in configuring Cisco network switches and wireless access points, and can manage third-party wiring vendors effectively. This role requires a commitment to extensive travel, flexibility to work off-hours and weekends, and a focus on delivering high-quality network solutions in a dynamic environment. Trilingual in Portuguese, English and Spanish. Key Responsibilities: - Configure switches and wireless access points.
- Perform site assessments to evaluate current network infrastructure and develop action plans for equipment refresh.
- Work collaboratively with wiring vendors to oversee and ensure proper cabling and device installations and terminations meet project standards.
- Manage and troubleshoot network issues during the deployment and provide Level 3 hyper care support as needed.
- Document network configurations, topologies, and changes to maintain accurate records.
- Adhere to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining high standards of quality and performance.
- Travel extensively (up to 25%) to various sites across South America, Mexico, the United States and Canada, including weekends and off-hours work as necessary. Qualifications: - Minimum Certification: CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate), CCNP (Cisco Certified Network Professional) preferred.
- Proven experience in deploying and managing network devices, including Cisco and Juniper switches and wireless access points.
- Strong knowledge of LAN/WLAN networking protocols.
- Familiarity with cabling standards and experience managing wiring vendors.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in fast-paced environments.
- Strong communication skills to interact effectively with team members, vendors, and stakeholders.
- Availability to travel internationally, extensively (up to 25%) and work weekends or during off-hours as required. Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Sr. Technical Customer Success Analyst
description: Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst Business Unit: Graphic Communications Location: Brazil, Remote Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst, you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success, you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success. In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues. Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability. Key Responsibilities Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy. Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence. Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact. Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions. Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment. Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance. Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution. Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions. Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details. Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation. Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues. Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases. Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics. Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers. Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity. Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates. Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements. Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required. Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures. Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL. Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers. Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools. Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries. Utilize network tracing tools (e.G., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues. Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues. Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components. Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments. Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators. Experience Requirements Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience. ERP/MIS background preferred. Print industry knowledge is mandatory. Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred. Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies. Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment. Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance. Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance. Willing to work in shifts as required. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Strong documentation and organizational abilities. Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics). Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication. Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL. Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting. Education Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems. Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

title: Senior Solution Architect (Remote)
description:
Olá! A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios. Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades. Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering, Data Analytics, Modern Applications e Cybersecurity, sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros. Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia;
é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business. Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade: ❇️ Descrição: Você liderará decisões arquiteturais de produtos e plataformas críticas, definindo conceitos fundamentais, elementos e relações do sistema conforme boas práticas de arquitetura. Você conectará estratégia de produto a soluções cloud‑native escaláveis, seguras e observáveis, promovendo governança técnica, redução de dívida e eficiência de custos (FinOps). ❇️ O seu papel no time: Definir e evoluir arquitetura (microserviços/event‑driven, APIs) com ADRs (Architecture Decision Records), padrões e guias — reduzindo retrabalho e melhorando coerência entre equipes. Estabelecer SLIs/SLOs (Service Level Indicators / Service Level Objectives) e observabilidade (logs, métricas, traces com OpenTelemetry) para diagnóstico ágil e MTTR menor. Planejar capacidade, desempenho e resiliência (caching, tolerância a falhas, back‑pressure) — melhorando disponibilidade. Eleger tecnologias (Azure/AWS/GCP, bancos relacionais/noSQL, mensageria) com análise de trade‑offs e custo total de propriedade. Governança técnica: promover boas práticas (DDD, testes, segurança por design), revisões arquiteturais e quality gates em CI/CD. Segurança/Privacidade: aplicar OAuth2/OIDC, criptografia, gestão de segredos e princípios LGPD. FinOps: co‑liderar otimização de uso e rates (tagueamento, unit economics), equilibrando custo vs. performance. Mentoria e influência: apoiar tech leads, alinhar com PO/PM, SRE/Operações e Segurança;
comunicar riscos, dependências e impactos. ❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills: Arquiteturas distribuídas (microserviços, event‑driven) e APIs REST/GraphQL. Event‑driven architecture: modelar domínios e eventos, Kafka (tópicos/partições, schema registry, DLQ), RabbitMQ — aumentando resiliência e throughput. Plataformas de integração: Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) e/ou OSB/ODI/CDC (OGG). Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP), Containers & Orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes) e IaC (Terraform/Helm). Observabilidade e SLIs/SLOs;
instrumentação e dashboards (ex.: Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry). CI/CD (GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps/GitLab), qualidade (SonarQube) e segurança (SAST/DAST). Bancos de dados (PostgreSQL/MongoDB/Redis), modelagem e performance. Segurança por design e LGPD. ❇️ Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Computação/Engenharia de Software/SI (ou experiência equivalente). ❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills: Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e de negócio Colaboração e influência sem autoridade;
facilitação de decisõesPensamento sistêmico e análise de trade‑offs;
mentoria Adaptabilidade Colaboração Foco no cliente Visão de dono ❇️ Qualificações preferenciais: Event sourcing, sagas, gRPC, estratégias blue/green/canary. Práticas SRE (erro budget, post‑mortem) e FinOps avançado. Certificações: Cloud Architect (AWS/Azure/GCP), CKA/CKAD, TOGAF (contexto EA), DASA/DevOps, SRE. ✨O que oferecemos (modalidade CLT): VR/VA de R$38/dia (cartão flexível);

title: Software Engineer Full Stack Pleno
description:
Quem somos? Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões de rodada em investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil. A TM Digital é a divisão tecnológica da TerraMagna responsável por levar todas as nossas inovações para o mercado. Nossa jornada começou com a tecnologia, identificamos os desafios comuns do agronegócio e expandimos para o financiamento graças à nossa expertise em gestão de riscos em tempo real, um reflexo da nossa solidez tecnológica. Nosso propósito é fortalecer a cadeia de distribuição de insumos e transformar a maneira como o crédito é concedido e recebido no agronegócio brasileiro. Por isso, dividimos a credibilidade tecnológica que permitiu a TerraMagna se tornar o que é para o mercado agro. A tecnologia está no centro do que fazemos. Nossas equipes de desenvolvimento, arquitetura de sistemas, banco de dados, experiência do usuário, cibersegurança e data & analytics atuam em conjunto para construir o sistema operacional do agronegócio. Em um setor que se transforma todos os dias, somos reconhecidos por liderar essa mudança com visão estratégica. Responsabilidades e atribuições: Desenvolver interfaces de usuário modernas e responsivas e participar ativamente da implementação de soluções escaláveis e resilientes;
Trabalhar transversalmente com squads, garantindo boas práticas de engenharia e decisões consistentes com a visão de longo prazo da plataforma;
Contribuir comrevisõesde código, design de sistemas, arquitetura e iniciativas de refatoração estratégica;
Colaborar com áreas deproduto e negócios para traduzir necessidades em soluções técnicas viáveis;
Garantir excelência naexperiência do usuário e performance front-end;
Conduzir iniciativas de inovação tecnológica, incluindo POCs e adoção de novas ferramentas ou paradigmas. Competências: Experiência com stacks como: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, Node.Js (NestJS), PostgreSQL.. Experiência anterior em ambientes altamente regulados ou em fintechs / agtechs / software as a service (saas);
Participação ativa em comunidades técnicas ou iniciativas open source;
Antifragilidade, pronto para desbravar entregas críticas para o sucesso do negócio;
Experiência com desenvolvimento de software e design de arquitetura de serviços e dados;
Excelentes habilidadesde comunicação e colaboração. Requisitos: Graduação em Engenharia;
Sólida experiência em engenharia de software (4+ anos), com histórico de impacto técnico significativo;
Experiência com Angular e desenvolvimento de SPAs (Single Page Applications);
Experiência com APIs REST;
Vivência com infraestrutura em nuvem (preferencialmente GCP), automação de infraestrutura (IaC), CI/CD e observabilidade;
Experiência com bancosde dados relacionais (preferencialmente PostgreSQL) e não relacionais em alta escala;
Habilidade de comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e não técnicas. Diferenciais: Conhecimento ou experiência com Rust;
Experiência com processamento de dados geoespaciais no front-end (mapas, geolocalização);
Conhecimento sobre os conceitos base da Cloud – containers, VMs e GCP (organização, projetos, regiões, zonas, IAM);
Conhecimento dos principais conceitos e funcionalidades como Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, etc;
Conhecimento em Terraform. O que temos por aqui: Remuneração compatível com o mercado (PJ);
Benefício flexível pormeio do cartão Swile;

title: Network Implementation Engineer
description:
Job Title: L3 Network Operations and Implementation Engineer – LAN/WLAN Job Summary: We are seeking a skilled and motivated L3 Network Engineer provide Level 3 network support and to implement LAN and WLAN infrastructure at sites across the North and South America. The ideal candidate will hold at least a CCNA certification, possess strong experience in configuring Cisco network switches and wireless access points, and can manage third-party wiring vendors effectively. This role requires a commitment to extensive travel, flexibility to work off-hours and weekends, and a focus on delivering high-quality network solutions in a dynamic environment. Trilingual in Portuguese, English and Spanish. Key Responsibilities: - Configure switches and wireless access points.
- Perform site assessments to evaluate current network infrastructure and develop action plans for equipment refresh.
- Work collaboratively with wiring vendors to oversee and ensure proper cabling and device installations and terminations meet project standards.
- Manage and troubleshoot network issues during the deployment and provide Level 3 hyper care support as needed.

- Proven experience in deploying and managing network devices, including Cisco and Juniper switches and wireless access points.
- Strong knowledge of LAN/WLAN networking protocols.
- Familiarity with cabling standards and experience managing wiring vendors.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in fast-paced environments.
- Strong communication skills to interact effectively with team members, vendors, and stakeholders.
- Availability to travel internationally, extensively (up to 25%) and work weekends or during off-hours as required. title: Sr. Technical Customer Success Analyst
description: Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst Business Unit: Graphic Communications Location: Brazil, Remote Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst, you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success, you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success. In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues. Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability. Key Responsibilities Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy. Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence. Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact. Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions. Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment. Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance. Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution. Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions. Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details. Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation. Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues. Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases. Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics. Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers. Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity. Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates. Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements. Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required. Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures. Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL. Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers. Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools. Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries. Utilize network tracing tools (e.G., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues. Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues. Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components. Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments. Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators. Experience Requirements Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience. ERP/MIS background preferred. Print industry knowledge is mandatory. Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred. Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies. Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment. Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance. Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance. Willing to work in shifts as required. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Strong documentation and organizational abilities. Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics). Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication. Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL. Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting. Education Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems. Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

title: Data Visualization Specialist
description: About the Product: For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections. Role Summary: We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio. Duties and Responsibilities: Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python) Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework. Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity. Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.G., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience. Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio. Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes. Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance. Data Querying and Performance Optimization Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions. Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load. Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.G., Python, SQL). User Experience (UX) and Data Design Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives. Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption. Knowledge/Skills/Abilities: Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio. Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git. Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer. Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery. Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly. Requirements: Advanced Proficiency in Shiny for Python: Deep expertise in developing, deploying, and managing production-grade Shiny applications, including a solid understanding of reactivity principles, modular design, and front-end styling. Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources. Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization. Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.G., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny. Experience with other BI platforms (e.G., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus. Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors. Credentials and Experience: College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field. 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment. We offer: We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health/Sport Budget. Fully remote.

title: Network Implementation Engineer
description:
Job Title: L3 Network Operations and Implementation Engineer – LAN/WLAN Job Summary: We are seeking a skilled and motivated L3 Network Engineer provide Level 3 network support and to implement LAN and WLAN infrastructure at sites across the North and South America. The ideal candidate will hold at least a CCNA certification, possess strong experience in configuring Cisco network switches and wireless access points, and can manage third-party wiring vendors effectively. This role requires a commitment to extensive travel, flexibility to work off-hours and weekends, and a focus on delivering high-quality network solutions in a dynamic environment. Trilingual in Portuguese, English and Spanish. Key Responsibilities: - Configure switches and wireless access points.
- Perform site assessments to evaluate current network infrastructure and develop action plans for equipment refresh.
- Work collaboratively with wiring vendors to oversee and ensure proper cabling and device installations and terminations meet project standards.
- Manage and troubleshoot network issues during the deployment and provide Level 3 hyper care support as needed.
- Document network configurations, topologies, and changes to maintain accurate records.
- Adhere to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining high standards of quality and performance.
- Travel extensively (up to 25%) to various sites across South America, Mexico, the United States and Canada, including weekends and off-hours work as necessary. Qualifications: - Minimum Certification: CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate), CCNP (Cisco Certified Network Professional) preferred.
- Proven experience in deploying and managing network devices, including Cisco and Juniper switches and wireless access points.
- Strong knowledge of LAN/WLAN networking protocols.
- Familiarity with cabling standards and experience managing wiring vendors.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in fast-paced environments.
- Strong communication skills to interact effectively with team members, vendors, and stakeholders.
- Availability to travel internationally, extensively (up to 25%) and work weekends or during off-hours as required. Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Network Implementation Engineer
description:
Job Title: L3 Network Operations and Implementation Engineer – LAN/WLAN Job Summary: We are seeking a skilled and motivated L3 Network Engineer provide Level 3 network support and to implement LAN and WLAN infrastructure at sites across the North and South America. The ideal candidate will hold at least a CCNA certification, possess strong experience in configuring Cisco network switches and wireless access points, and can manage third-party wiring vendors effectively. - Document network configurations, topologies, and changes to maintain accurate records.

- Proven experience in deploying and managing network devices, including Cisco and Juniper switches and wireless access points.
- Strong knowledge of LAN/WLAN networking protocols.
- Familiarity with cabling standards and experience managing wiring vendors.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in fast-paced environments.
- Strong communication skills to interact effectively with team members, vendors, and stakeholders.
- Availability to travel internationally, extensively (up to 25%) and work weekends or during off-hours as required. title: Network Implementation Engineer
description:

- Proven experience in deploying and managing network devices, including Cisco and Juniper switches and wireless access points.
- Strong knowledge of LAN/WLAN networking protocols.
- Familiarity with cabling standards and experience managing wiring vendors.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in fast-paced environments.
- Strong communication skills to interact effectively with team members, vendors, and stakeholders.
- Availability to travel internationally, extensively (up to 25%) and work weekends or during off-hours as required. title: Sr. Technical Customer Success Analyst
description: Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst Business Unit: Graphic Communications Location: Brazil, Remote Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst, you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success, you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success. In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues. Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability. Key Responsibilities Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy. Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence. Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact. Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions. Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment. Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance. Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution. Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions. Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details. Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation. Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues. Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases. Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics. Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers. Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity. Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates. Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements. Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required. Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures. Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL. Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers. Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools. Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries. Utilize network tracing tools (e.G., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues. Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues. Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components. Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments. Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators. Experience Requirements Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience. ERP/MIS background preferred. Print industry knowledge is mandatory. Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred. Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies. Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment. Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance. Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance. Willing to work in shifts as required. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Strong documentation and organizational abilities. Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics). Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication. Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL. Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting. Education Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems. Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries. Utilize network tracing tools (e.G., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues. Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues. Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components. Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments. Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators. Experience Requirements Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience. ERP/MIS background preferred. Print industry knowledge is mandatory. Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred. Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies. Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment. Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance. Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance. Willing to work in shifts as required. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Strong documentation and organizational abilities. Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics). Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication. Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL. Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting. Education Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems. Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

title: Network Implementation Engineer
description:
Job Title: L3 Network Operations and Implementation Engineer – LAN/WLAN Job Summary: We are seeking a skilled and motivated L3 Network Engineer provide Level 3 network support and to implement LAN and WLAN infrastructure at sites across the North and South America. The ideal candidate will hold at least a CCNA certification, possess strong experience in configuring Cisco network switches and wireless access points, and can manage third-party wiring vendors effectively. This role requires a commitment to extensive travel, flexibility to work off-hours and weekends, and a focus on delivering high-quality network solutions in a dynamic environment. Trilingual in Portuguese, English and Spanish. Key Responsibilities: - Configure switches and wireless access points.
- Perform site assessments to evaluate current network infrastructure and develop action plans for equipment refresh.
- Work collaboratively with wiring vendors to oversee and ensure proper cabling and device installations and terminations meet project standards.
- Manage and troubleshoot network issues during the deployment and provide Level 3 hyper care support as needed.
- Document network configurations, topologies, and changes to maintain accurate records.
- Adhere to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining high standards of quality and performance.
- Travel extensively (up to 25%) to various sites across South America, Mexico, the United States and Canada, including weekends and off-hours work as necessary. Qualifications: - Minimum Certification: CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate), CCNP (Cisco Certified Network Professional) preferred.
- Proven experience in deploying and managing network devices, including Cisco and Juniper switches and wireless access points.
- Strong knowledge of LAN/WLAN networking protocols.
- Familiarity with cabling standards and experience managing wiring vendors.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in fast-paced environments.
- Strong communication skills to interact effectively with team members, vendors, and stakeholders.
- Availability to travel internationally, extensively (up to 25%) and work weekends or during off-hours as required.
